title: Observability Module
summary: This module provides tools for monitoring and understanding the system's behavior, including logging, metrics collection, and health checks. It helps ensure the application's operational health and performance.

nodes.label: Logging System
nodes.title: Logging System
nodes.description: Captures and stores application events, errors, and debugging information for analysis and troubleshooting.

nodes.label: System Metrics
nodes.title: System Metrics Collection
nodes.description: Collects and exposes key performance indicators and operational statistics to monitor system health and performance.

nodes.label: Health Checks
nodes.title: Health Check Endpoints
nodes.description: Provides endpoints for external systems to verify the application's operational status and readiness.

nodes.label: Alerting Mechanism
nodes.title: Alerting Mechanism
nodes.description: Triggers notifications based on predefined thresholds or anomalies detected in logs or metrics.

nodes.label: External Monitoring Tools
nodes.title: External Monitoring Tools
nodes.description: Third-party systems or dashboards that consume observability data for visualization and analysis.

groups.label: Observability Data Sources
groups.title: Observability Data Sources
groups.description: These components generate the raw data necessary for monitoring and understanding the system's state and performance.

groups.label: Observability Data Consumers
groups.title: Observability Data Consumers
groups.description: These components utilize the collected observability data to provide insights, trigger alerts, and visualize system health.
